name: The Possah
notes:
Header logo is two PNGs side by side (served through the Next.js image optimiser; originals saved): an icon mark /images/logo.png (1024x1024) and a wordmark image /images/name.png (1536x1024, alt 'The Possah'). No SVG (requests for .svg return the HTML app shell). No separate light logo: the footer (background #1f3a2d) reuses the same two images with no filter. Accent is the filled 'SHOP THE COLLECTION' button (#1f3a2d bg, #f4ecdf text). Headings: Playfair Display; body: Inter; nav and small text: JetBrains Mono. Favicon: /icon.png (512x512) is the largest; apple-icon.png is 180x180. Original image files are NOT included in this package: the build workspace cannot reach this site directly and the browser channel cannot transfer binary files. Run fetch_assets.sh (in the brand-assets root) to download the originals listed in sources.txt into this folder unchanged.
